question: How should the practitioner draw in the vital air at the root of tongue and palate?
premises: The locus is the root of tongue and palate
The vital air is to be taken in
The action must be done slowly
inference: The practitioner should slowly draw in the vital air at the root of the tongue and palate.
plain_english: Having placed it at the root of the tongue and palate, one should slowly drink in the air.
